Fusion GRB-908 6-Inch Rustic Sand Cast Bronze Refrigerator/Appliance Pulls

This 6 inch appliance pull is crafted using sand casting with solid bronze for a true rustic appearance. Fusion hardware famous for their high quality craftmanship and distinctive designs at affordable prices.

6" center to center mounting.
Packaged with appliance panel mounting screws.


Available in Medium Bronze or Dark Bronze finish.
